largeGroupThresholdHint: Up to this number of guests Sofia books on her own; above it she hands the call back to an operator. The backend availability check is not reliable for large groups (it checks single tables), so the threshold exists to avoid giving the guest a wrong answer.
doubleSeatingLabel: Double seating on the same table
doubleSeatingHint: When on, Sofia can give a table a second sitting in the same service: the table frees up at the end of the previous booking (duration from the booking dialog; with no duration, 90 minutes at lunch and 120 at dinner). When the service is full she offers the guest the time the first suitable table frees up. Phone channel only.
scheduledSuspensionsHint: Turns the suspension on automatically in one or more scheduled windows: pick the day and a whole service (lunch or dinner), or a custom time range. When the current time enters a window, Sofia announces the suspension and invites the guest to ring back after that window's end time. The immediate switch above still takes precedence when on.
callbackTimeTitle: Time Sofia gives the guest to ring back
noBlockedDays: No blocked days. Sofia books for any date.
voiceBlockCallbackTitle: When Sofia invites the caller to ring back to speak to an operator
webBlocksLabel: Block web bookings on specific days
webBlocksHint: Close the web channel for one service (lunch or dinner) or for the whole day. The /prenota form hides blocked slots and rejects direct POST attempts. Expired blocks are removed automatically on the next load.
noWebBlocks: No blocks scheduled. The web channel is open every day.
noSpecificSettings: No specific settings for now beyond on / suspended.
roomOccupancyCapsSubtitle: Share of tables or covers above which automatic bookings go through the staff.
capsExplainer: Reserve a share of each dining room for the channels you handle. Example with 70% on the Macine room: while Macine stays under 70%, web bookings for that room are confirmed straight away with a table assigned automatically; as soon as it hits 70% new requests stay to be confirmed by hand and the phone agent stops offering the room. Staff keep booking without limits from the CRM.
adminsOnly: Only administrators can change these settings.
basisTablesHint: : tables taken out of the room's total (a merged table, or one held by an event, counts as taken).
basisSeatsHint: : guests booked out of the total seats. Web requests still without a table count towards the room the guest chose.

firstMessageHintA: The first sentence Sofia says when she answers. Edit it here rather than in ElevenLabs. Use
firstMessageHintB: to insert the guest's name when the number is recognised (it is dropped for unknown callers). Leave empty to use the default message.
bookingsSuspendedHintA: When on, Sofia answers the call saying bookings are suspended and invites the caller to ring back after the time set. The tools
bookingsSuspendedHintB: are also disabled as a safety net.
operatorOnlyDaysHintB: these days (or services), whatever time the call comes in: useful when there is a set menu or an event you want to handle by hand. To a guest asking for a blocked date Sofia says the staff will take care of it and invites them to ring back at the times given. Other dates stay bookable as usual. Blocks already in the past disappear on their own.
